title: elymus praeruptus
intro: Elymus praeruptus, commonly known as the rough bent grass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including gastrointestinal problems, respiratory issues, and fever, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Elymus praeruptus include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
